description: GateLab's own basic cores, each with a self-checking testbench: UART, SPI, I²C, debouncer, edge detector, FIFOs, clock divider, PWM, seven-segment display, WS2812 LEDs, VGA/DVI timing, sprite, text, bar graph and analogue clock layers, I2S audio (clocks, transmitter, receiver) and a sine tone generator, SPI registers for a microcontroller, TMDS encoding, an HDMI/DVI encoder with audio and HDMI/DVI outputs for AMD Xilinx 7-series, Gowin, ECP5 and GateMate, Ethernet over an RMII, MII or RGMII PHY (MAC, MDIO, ARP, ping, UDP and stacks of them all), keyboard and mouse from GateLab over the board's UART, and 10 Gigabit Ethernet: the Kintex-7's GTX transceivers at 10.3125 Gb/s with PRBS31, a 10GBASE-R PCS and a 10G MAC. CC0 1.0: no conditions, no attribution needed.
name: GateLab Essentials
